correctness.rationale: The upper bound follows from 2^{binom(k,2)} one-vertex witness profiles, a 2^k-coloring of pairs inside one profile class, the definition of R_{2^k}(3), hereditary preservation under induced substructures containing the witnesses, and a three-variable cloning argument. Sharpness is realized by a Ramsey-critical 2^k-coloring in every one-vertex profile class.
